blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The group Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) on Wednesday called on the government to withdraw from the Pax Silica coalition. The clamor comes amid confirmation from President Marcos that there will be no signing of the agreement during US President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines. “Marcos’ statement that there will be no Pax Silica signing is misleading because we are still part of the coalition [after] we joined it last April, and we already signed the critical minerals deal last February,” the group said in a statement. “We dare Marcos to withdraw the country’s membership from Pax Silica and stop […]...
